whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation". It is crafted from 3 Rada Fruit, Beast Liver, Scorpion Liver, and Yellow Fulgurbloom, using the recipe from Forager Brood Cookbook 3.

effect: Temporarily grants large boost to lightning damage negation

A feeble man sought power through the grotesque act of grafting. "One day we'll return together, to our home, bathed in rays of gold."

A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.

Miquella and Malenia are both the children of a single god. As such they are both Empyreans, but suffered afflictions from birth. One was cursed with eternal childhood, and the other harbored rot within.

After the church was burned to the ground, Romina discovered a twisted divine element, which she weaved into the baleful scarlet rot. Perhaps then, the buds might find somewhere to gain purchase once more, within the scorched remains.

Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer.

desc: Spirit ash of those who came before, infused with potent spirituality. Acquired from the corpses of hornsent and other objects that ritually decorate townships and villages across the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Revered Spirit Ash Blessing. The Revered Spirit Ash Blessing bolsters both summoned spirits' and spectral steed's abilities to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. The withered corpses were called tutelary deities, and Revered Spirit Ash was said to quietly accumulate in the palms of their hands.
location: There are a total of 25 Revered Spirit Ashes within the Land of Shadow. Gravesite Plain contains 9 of them. One is at the eastern cliff on an altar, near a waterfall, to the west of the Church of Consolation and east of Scorched Ruins. One is in the Abandoned Ailing Village on an altar...
whatItIs: Revered Spirit Ash is an upgrade material. The carry limit is 99.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Reduces the damage taken by Torrent".
whenToUse: Its location note points to the Land of Shadow.
name: Revered Spirit Ash
effect: Reduces the damage taken by Torrent and Spirit Ashes and increases the damage dealt by Spirit Ashes

location: Given to the player by Mad Tongue Alberich in the Roundtable Hold. Alberich will invade in the great hall bellow the balcony, where he will perform the gesture himself before engaging in combat. The gesture is received when he completes the animation.

whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Locks player in place.

whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: Found in Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Rimed Crystal Bud

whatItIs: Rimed Rowa counts as a crafting material. Up to 999 fit in your inventory.
whyItMatters: In practice, its recorded effect: Material used for crafting items. Frozen Raisin is what it teaches.
whenToUse: It is an enemy drop.
name: Rimed Rowa

Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts Dragon Communion incantations. The last thing the partaker saw with human eyes was a sunset, its colors faded and tarnished—a remote thing from eternity.
location: Loot: Jagged Peak After finding the "Domain of Dragons" Painting, start at the Jagged Peak Mountainside Site of Grace and head up the mountain to a Spiritspring. Transforms the user into a dragon
Grants a temporary boost to Dragon Communion Incantations

The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

The maggots found in waste feed on blood and turn into vicious flies that are pitiably short-lived.

It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

whatItIs: Turtle Neck Meat counts as a crafting material. The carry limit is 999.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Crafting". Pickled Turtle Neck is what it teaches.
whenToUse: It is for sale from Twin Maiden Husks in Altus Plateau.
name: Turtle Neck Meat

desc: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction prevents one's runes from being lost upon death. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.
location: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts) Found at a sap collection basin at the foot of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree, along with the Right version of the Crimson Crystal Tear. It is guarded by a group of Death Serving Commoners and an Omen.
whatItIs: Twiggy Cracked Tear is a crystal tear.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick.
whenToUse: Look for it at Minor Erdtree.
name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
effect: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick

desc: Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations:
location: Fortified Manor in the Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Two Fingers' Prayerbook is a key item.
whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: Its location note points to Leyndell, Royal Capital.
name: Two Fingers' Prayerbook

desc: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. Sage Gowry has designs for this needle.
whatItIs: Unalloyed Gold Needle is a key item.
whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: It stays with you until called for.
name: Unalloyed Gold Needle

desc: Art of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to raise the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half. This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.
location: Crafted with Perfumer's Cookbook [1].
whatItIs: Uplifting Aromatic is a consumable (Perfume). The carry limit is 10.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Boosts ally attack power and reduces incoming damage once. Crafting it takes Perfume Bottle, Altus Bloom, Arteria Leaf, Budding Cave Moss, and Silver Tear Husk once Perfumer's Cookbook 1 has taught you the recipe.
whenToUse: Craft it whenever you are carrying Perfume Bottle, Altus Bloom, Arteria Leaf, Budding Cave Moss, and Silver Tear Husk.
name: Uplifting Aromatic
effect: Boosts ally attack power and reduces incoming damage once

desc: Golden prosthesis once used by the one-armed valkyrie. A masterwork of craftsmanship, with practice and skill it can be used as proficiently as a real arm. When Maleigh Marais, Lord of the Shaded Castle embraced this prosthesis, he claimed to feel the presence of his personal goddess.
location: Found in a treasure chest guarded by a Cleanrot Knight in the Shaded Castle. The chest is in the northwest most corner of the castle. It is most easily reached by following the inner wall towards the west.
whatItIs: Valkyrie's Prosthesis is a key item that stays in your inventory.
whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: A chest holds it.
name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis

desc: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages, where the scattered sap of the Scadutree pools deep within the furnace golems. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction eliminates all stamina consumption. However, this effect is only brief and will quickly expire.
location: Guaranteed drop: Gravesite Plain Dropped by the Furnace Golem found south of the Ellac River Downstream Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain, on the path to the Cerulean Coast.
whatItIs: Viridian Hidden Tear counts as a crystal tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Eliminates all stamina consumption in mixed physick".
whenToUse: It drops from Furnace Golem in Gravesite Plain.
name: Viridian Hidden Tear
effect: Eliminates all stamina consumption in mixed physick

desc: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.
whatItIs: Vision of Grace is a tool.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Lose all runes, return to last site.
whenToUse: Equip it to a quick slot.
name: Vision of Grace
effect: Lose all runes, return to last site of lost grace

desc: A smoldering rock containing hot gas. Material used for crafting items. Found on Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Volcanic Stone is a crafting material. The carry limit is 999.
whyItMatters: Put simply, what it does, per the record: Material used for crafting items.
whenToUse: Hold it for crafting recipes.
name: Volcanic Stone

desc: Letter given by Rya as thanks for retrieving her necklace. Contains an invitation to Volcano Manor. "Brave Tarnished, Seek the Altus Plateau in the realm of the Erdtree. Prove yourself by making this journey, and the Volcano Manor will fully extend its invitation. To fight, amongst a family of champions."
location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Scenic Isle) Quest: Rya the Scout. Given by her in the gazebo east of the Site of Grace, after retrieving Rya's Necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart by either purchasing it for 1000 Runes or killing him.
whatItIs: Volcano Manor Invitation is a key item that stays in your inventory.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Grants access to the Volcano Manor through Rya".
whenToUse: Located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
name: Volcano Manor Invitation
effect: Grants access to the Volcano Manor through Rya in Altus Plateau.

desc: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Powdered volcanic rock is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to disperse a cloud of heat, dealing continuous damage to those caught inside for a short duration.
location: Craftable after purchasing the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [20] from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) for 3,000 runes Volcanic Stones are readily available in large quantities along the Seethewater River at Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Volcano Pot is a consumable (Throwing Pot). The carry limit is 20.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous fire damage. It is crafted from Cracked Pot and 2 Volcanic Stone, using the recipe from Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook 20.
whenToUse: The record places it in Mt. Gelmir. Make it on the spot when you have Cracked Pot and 2 Volcanic Stone in your pouch.
name: Volcano Pot
effect: Creates heat cloud, causing continuous fire damage

location: Available from the start of the game.
whatItIs: Wait! is a gesture (an emote).
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Locks player in place.
whenToUse: For Wait!, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
name: Wait!

location: Available from the start of the game.
whatItIs: Warm Welcome is a gesture.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Locks player in place.
whenToUse: For Warm Welcome, you have it from the start of the game.
name: Warm Welcome

desc: Ruin Fragment blessed with an incantation of the Two Fingers. Craftable item. Uses FP to generate warmth, continuously restoring the HP of those nearby. It's said that the Erdtree was once as warm as the gentle sun, and would gradually heal all who bathed in its rays.
location: Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise (same one with the Great Turtle Shell). Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower. Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], found north of the Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) within...
whatItIs: Warming Stone is a consumable item you use up. The carry limit is 10.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies.
whenToUse: Look for it in Altus Plateau.
name: Warming Stone
effect: Uses FP to continuously heal nearby allies

location: Available from the start of the game.
whatItIs: Wave is a gesture (an emote).
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Makes a waving gesture.
whenToUse: For Wave, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
name: Wave

desc: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion. She wishes for it to be returned to its rightful owner. It was once a special weapon of gold and silver intertwined, but is now worn down and marred by a black gash.
location: Given by Fia as part of her questline; belonged to D, Hunter of the Dead.
whatItIs: Weathered Dagger counts as a key item that stays in your inventory.
whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: You get it through Fia.
name: Weathered Dagger

desc: A simple, badly weathered map. Left discarded and forgotten for some time. Depicts streaks of amber light.
location: Can be bought from Pidia for 600 runes.
whatItIs: Weathered Map counts as a key item that stays in your inventory.
whyItMatters: No effect text is recorded for it.
whenToUse: Pidia sells it for 600 runes.
name: Weathered Map

desc: A crude, corroded key. Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat, the tower settlement.
location: Located in Belurat, Tower Settlement. From rooftops guarded by Gravebirds, drop from the South-East corner of the northernmost roof onto a drapery. The drapery leads to a covered bridge, from which you can reach a room containing two enemies and the Well Depths Key.
whatItIs: Well Depths Key is a key item that stays in your inventory.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Opens the iron grating at the bottom".
whenToUse: South-East can drop it.
name: Well Depths Key
effect: Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat

desc: Turtle neck meat that has been thoroughly pickled in a bitter solution. Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed. The effects of the forager brood's pickled delights are enhanced by the fermentation, or rotting, of the ingredients. Though this results in a pungent odor, some come to find the aroma irresistible.
location: Craft: Scadu Altus Can be crafted after acquiring the Forager Brood Cookbook [6]. Talk to the forager brood member located near the walls of the Shadow Keep, Church District, northwest of the Church District Highroad site of grace. Purchase: Gravesite Plain 1 is sold for 2 000 Runes by Moore at...
whatItIs: Well-Pickled Turtle Neck counts as a consumable item you use up. You can hold up to 10.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed". It is crafted from 3 Rada Fruit, Turtle Neck Meat, Scorpion Liver, and Dewgem, using the recipe from Forager Brood Cookbook 6.
whenToUse: Look for it in Scadu Altus. Make it on the spot when you have 3 Rada Fruit, Turtle Neck Meat, Scorpion Liver, and Dewgem in your pouch.
name: Well-Pickled Turtle Neck
effect: Temporarily grants large boost to stamina recovery speed

location: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold Given to the player after attempting to speak with Ensha of the Royal Remains next to Gideon's study in the Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: What Do You Want? is a gesture.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Locks player in place.
whenToUse: Located at Roundtable Hold Given.
name: What Do You Want?

desc: Whetstone with a cipher inscription, made to look like a small knifeblade. Allows the use of ashes of war at a site of grace to bestow new battle arts and affinities to armaments as skills. The battle arts and affinities will depend on the ashes of war used.
location: It's found at Gatefront Ruins, in the cellar's chest, alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp. Also sold for 500 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks if any Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes is activated without picking it up.
whatItIs: Whetstone Knife is a whetblade.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Can add new battle arts and affinities to weapons".
whenToUse: It is for sale from Twin Maiden Husks for 500 runes in Liurnia of the Lakes.
name: Whetstone Knife
effect: Can add new battle arts and affinities to weapons

desc: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.) Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (Summoning is not always possible.) One of the lost mystic codes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.
whatItIs: White Cipher Ring is a tool.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: when invaded, requests the aid of a hunter.
whenToUse: Equip it to a quick slot.
name: White Cipher Ring
effect: When invaded, requests the aid of a hunter

desc: Milky-white mushroom that grows in sullen lands. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the realm of shadow. The flesh of the mushroom is similar to raw meat, and can serve as pot innards.
location: Whiteflesh Mushrooms are commonly harvested throughout the Gravesite Plain. Can be dropped by Shadow Nobles.
whatItIs: Whiteflesh Mushroom is a crafting material. The carry limit is 999.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Crafting. Eternal Sleep Pot, Frenzied Flame Pot, Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot, and Hefty Oil Pot and 2 more are what it teaches.
whenToUse: It drops from Shadow Nobles in Gravesite Plain.
name: Whiteflesh Mushroom

desc: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction increases the effectiveness of dodge rolls for a certain duration. However, damage taken is also increased during the concoction's effect.
location: Loot: Caelid Looted from a bowl in southern Caelid, at the bottom of a cliff south of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Windy Crystal Tear is a crystal tear.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Enhances dodge rolls for a time in mixed physick.
whenToUse: Look for it at Caelid Looted in Caelid.
name: Windy Crystal Tear
effect: Enhances dodge rolls for a time in mixed physick

desc: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Temporarily reduces equipment load.
location: Loot: Capital Outskirts Found in a sap collection basin on top of some cliffs west of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree and east of Hermit Merchant's Shack. It is guarded by a group of Skeletal Snails, with an additional Deathbird at night.
whatItIs: Winged Crystal Tear is a crystal tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick.
whyItMatters: What it does, per the record: Temporarily reduces equip load in mixed physick.
whenToUse: Look for it at Capital Outskirts.
name: Winged Crystal Tear
effect: Temporarily reduces equip load in mixed physick

desc: Winged insect carrying a dangling frenzied flame grape. Material used for crafting items. Flies lazily around the abyssal forest. Said to be heralds of the aging untouchables. On seeing these, the wise know to stay well clear of that place.
location: Found in the Abyssal Woods.
whatItIs: Winter-Lantern Fly counts as a crafting material. The carry limit is 999.
whyItMatters: Its recorded effect: Crafting. Picking it up unlocks Frenzied Flame Pot, Roped Frenzied Flame Pot, and Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot.
whenToUse: Look for it in Abyssal Woods.
name: Winter-Lantern Fly

desc: Bell used by worshippers of revenants. Ring bell, using FP to summon prowling wraiths. This can be done multiple times in a row. Wraiths are said to be the vengeful spirits of those who died when cursed.
location: Loot: Laskyar Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest in the underground room of Laskyar Ruins.
whatItIs: Wraith Calling Bell is a reusable tool item.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Uses FP to ring bell and calls prowling wraiths".
whenToUse: A chest at Laskyar Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes holds it.
name: Wraith Calling Bell
effect: Uses FP to ring bell and calls prowling wraiths

desc: An ember taken from the eye socket of a corpse. Material used for crafting items. A sign that the deceased suffered from the flame of frenzy. This grape has ripened and burst.
whatItIs: Yellow Ember is a crafting material. You can hold up to 999.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Crafting".
whenToUse: Hold it for crafting recipes.
name: Yellow Ember

desc: Yellow flower that crackles with lightning. Material used for crafting items. Blossoms in the realm of shadow's underground gravesites and places struck by lightning. Imbued with yellow lightning's essence.
location: Yellow Fulgurbloom is found in the catacombs in the Realm of Shadow: Fog Rift Catacombs, Scorpion River Catacombs, and Darklight Catacombs. Found in the lightning-struck forest downstream of the Ellac River.
whatItIs: Yellow Fulgurbloom is a crafting material. Up to 999 fit in your inventory.
whyItMatters: The record lists its effect as "Crafting". Picking it up unlocks Dragonbolt Grease, Drawstring Dragonbolt Grease, Hefty Lightning Pot, and Lightningproof Pickled Liver.
whenToUse: Found in the Land of Shadow.
name: Yellow Fulgurbloom

desc: Bell bearing of Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, found upon his perished flesh. Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who...
whatItIs: Ymir's Bell Bearing is a bell bearing that unlocks shop stock when handed in.
whyItMatters: For Ymir's Bell Bearing, the record lists its effect as "Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access".
whenToUse: Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers has to fall first in Scadu Altus before you get this bell bearing.
name: Ymir's Bell Bearing
effect: Offer to Twin Maiden Husks for new item access
